CLINICAL INFORMATION
Diagnosis: Myeloma
Referring Physician: Dr. [redacted name]

TEST PERFORMED
Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) analysis on CD138+ purified cells

METHODOLOGY
CD138+ plasma cells were isolated from bone marrow aspirate using immunomagnetic selection. FISH analysis was performed on purified CD138+ cells using the following probe panel for myeloma:
- IGH/FGFR3 dual fusion probe
- IGH/MAF dual fusion probe
- IGH/CCND1 dual fusion probe
- 1p32/1q21 probe
- TP53/CEP17 probe
- 13q14/13q34 probe

Minimum of 200 interphase nuclei analyzed per probe set.

RESULTS
FISH analysis on bone marrow CD138+ purified cells completed.

Detailed FISH results to follow in supplemental report.

NOTE
G-banded chromosome analysis not required. Sample processed for FISH studies only.

Authorized by: Dr. [redacted name], Director of Cytogenetics
Electronically signed: [redacted date]
